verdict.rationale: Docs show Mem0 automatically extracts individual facts from raw conversation and organizes them into a graph without user-defined schema (mem0-docs-26, mem0-docs-8, mem0-docs-38, mem0-docs-42), and the search/retrieval flow lets the system decide what's salient (mem0-docs-7, mem0-docs-43). However, evidence of true background 'self-improving' consolidation (deduping, merging over time) is thin, and one independent report notes Mem0 doesn't implicitly learn behavioral patterns beyond stored facts (mem0-comm-7), tempering the 'decides for itself' framing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/evidence of background consolidation jobs or memory merging over time, and independent hands-on validation of extraction quality.
